note: Hand-written file contract for the R05 (Lot) normal enemies E1-E3. Same 32 px rules as art 03 / R02 / R03 / R04 (PPU 32, pivot (16,1), art faces right, flipX once on the parent, binary alpha). All three only chase and touch: no projectile, dash, debuff, forced movement or damage-ground art. Gameplay numbers belong to Core and the catalog.
pivotSpace: pixel-edge coordinates, origin at the bottom-left corner of one frame cell, x right, y up
frameLayout: one horizontal strip per clip; frame i occupies x = i*cell.w .. (i+1)*cell.w, full height; no padding

flip.note: flip once on the actor's parent (or its single renderer), same rule as art 03 / R02 / R03 / R04

alphaPolicies.binary: alpha is 0 or 255 only; RGB is 0 wherever alpha is 0

edgeMargin.why: no opaque pixel in the outer 1 px ring of a frame, so Point filtering and flipX never cut the outline; ground sprites stand on the foot row = cell.h - 1 - pivot.y

assets.use: chase loop: a waddling sack that is mostly a chomping mouth (open, closing, shut, opening), gold crown and coins. The chomp is look only: contact damage stays Core's ordinary touch
slow chase loop: the body creeps forward while one long arm drags behind, fingers scraping the ground. The arm is look only: it never pulls or holds the player and has no reach of its own
fast chase loop: a lean sprinter wrapped in smoke with ember eyes. The smoke stays inside the 32 px clip; it is not a cloud, trail decal or damage area

notProduced.smoke trail / cloud decal: not made on purpose: E3 has no damage ground, and a lingering smoke decal could read as one
notProduced.projectile, dash, pull or debuff art: E1-E3 are chase + contact only in R05
notProduced.death / hit clips: not in the R05 brief; the existing shared enemy hit/death handling applies

motifs.source: Genesis 13:10-13 (Lot chooses the well-watered plain toward Sodom), 19:16 (Lot lingers), 19:26 (looking back) and 19:28 (smoke rising from the plain like a furnace). Creative adaptation for the game.
motifs.e1: greed as a gold-decked purse-like creature that is mostly mouth (a created monster)
motifs.e2: lingering as a hooded creeper whose long arm keeps reaching back to what it left (a created monster; not Lot's wife and not a pillar of salt)
motifs.e3: a lean runner wrapped in the smoke of the burning plain, ember-eyed (a created monster; not the fire and brimstone of the judgment itself)
motifs.excluded: Lot, Lot's wife, his daughters, Abraham, the angels, God, the judgment fire and the pillar of salt are never enemies or enemy effects. No burning city, victims or human figures are drawn
